Name: Sir Robert's Mighty Marigolds
Author: sirrobertsmom
Description:
[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Description[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]This mod adds a variety of cheerful flowers to decorative your home in Stardew Valley. I've been attempting to create the perfect marigold with mixed results and in a fit of vextation, I decided to create a mod using ONLY orange and yellow. (The key was to use a desaturated color palette with a little bit of brown and that did the trick). I figured that one of them was bound to have the appearance of a marigold and I'm pleased to say that the results fill me with happiness! Plus, it was sooo much easier using a limited color palette that I may decide to do this for future mods. Because I cannot stop creating flower mods and I'm not sorry.[/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]There are 14 flower images alternating in orange or yellow blossoms with light-colored centers. The only exception is a yellow flower with a large dark-colored center because it didn't look right otherwise, so I'd say it's a black-eyed susan rather than a marigold. [/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Each image has variety of colorful pots to chose from. You can go wild and crazy with decorating! Mix and match with my other floral mods! Happy decorating to all![/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Install the latest version of SMAPI. Download this mod and unzip it directly into Stardew Valley/Mods. When you play the game, the images will be found in the Decor/Houseplants section of the furniture catalog or Happy Home Designer. [/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Images #1 through #14 can be placed upon [u]end tables[/u]. [/size][/color]

[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Image #15 have been moved up a few pixels and can be placed upon [u]countertops[/u]. [/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]Requires the Content Patcher and Alternative Textures. I also recommend using Happy Home Designer.[/size][/color]

[u][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size][/color][/u]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=4]All the end tables in the pictures are from mods made by Platinum Cats or lululovely. I also used end tables from the furniture catalog in the game. The countertops are also made by Platinum Cats and lululovely.[/size][/color]
